A '''blaster carbine''' was a shortened variant of an already existing weapon, traditionally [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]]. An individual who specialized at using carbines was known as a '''carbineer'''.

==Description==
[[File:Conscript_Carbine.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A conscript blaster carbine]]
A blaster carbine had a short [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] and compact two-handed grip, making it look more like a long pistol than a rifle.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> Carbines offered distinct advantages from other weapons. First and foremost, they were generally shorter and lighter than their heavier cousins, and allowed for more capabilities especially in confined environments;<ref name="TRG1-" /> they also had a faster rate of fire than a typical blaster rifle. In addition, carbines were often cheaper to produce than ordinary rifles. In exchange for these advantages however, they had a shorter range, less accuracy<ref name="TRG1-" /> and less stopping power. Blaster carbines had a short-range [[Stun/Legends|stun]] setting as well as an autofire setting, which allowed the weapon to fire multiple shots at a greater area instead of the more accurate single-shot mode. The blaster carbine cost 850 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] without a retractable stock and 900 credits with that accessory. Its ownership and use was regulated by local authorities.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

Some blaster carbines, such as the [[E5 blaster carbine]] used by [[B1-series battle droid|B1 battle droids]], had a [[Stock/Legends|retractable stock]]. When the stock was folded, it allowed the user to treat the weapon as a one-handed pistol. When the stock was extended, the user could treat the weapon more like a rifle with greater range. However, the extended stock required that the weapon be used with two hands to be used properly.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

==History==
Despite these disadvantages, carbines were generally simpler and easier to use than [[Rifle/Legends|rifles]], and were therefore very popular with unskilled thugs or civilian owners looking for simplicity, ruggedness and ease of use. They were frequently used by nomads such as the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TRG1-" /> Many a frontier homeowner had a carbine for home security. [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] owned a blaster carbine at his [[Lars homestead/Legends|homestead]] on Tatooine for defense against marauding Tusken Raiders. However, many people skilled in ranged weapons often preferred these weapons as well. They were often issued to walker assault teams.<ref name="TRG1-" />

Perhaps the best-known example was [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] modified [[EE-3 carbine rifle/Legends|EE-3 carbine rifle]]. [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] were also known to prefer a N'Gant-Zarvel [[9118 heavy carbine]] during their missions, despite its characteristic ''thud'' made when firing.
